title: Realizing crosscap transpositions as monodromies of singular fibrations
summary: We introduce a new type of singularity for smooth maps from $4$-manifolds to surfaces, called an $M$-singularity, whose critical locus is a circle contained in a single fiber. We show that the monodromy around an $M$-singularity is a crosscap transposition in the mapping class group of a non-orientable surface. We also introduce $M$-fibrations, namely smooth maps whose singularities consist only of $M$-singularities, and prove that relations among crosscap transpositions give rise to such fibrations on non-orientable $4$-manifolds.
